text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbank,
I spotted Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this poster?
'Running School, Now Enrolling Students'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Running school... Ah, THAT place!
They charge a fortune, so only rich spoiled kids
can get in.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This world's so cruel. Instead of just polishin'
rich kids, how about polishin' talented poor kids?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait... huh? Rain?! Today's just one thing after
another! Gotta take cover, gotta take cover!

Seeking shelter from the rain as well, I headed
towards the riverbank bridge. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, looks like you're taking shelter...
What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you just said it yourself, Oguri!
Exactly what it looks like: takin' shelter!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, today's been a total disaster. Gettin' caught
in sudden rain, seein' an annoying poster...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Hey, Oguri. Have you ever been
to a running school?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A running school... We didn't have anything like
that in the countryside. What about you, Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I... couldn't go. I wanted to train hard
and escape poverty, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why not?! Why won't ya let me into this
school?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In the future, I'm gonna enter tons of races,
win 'em all, and rake in piles of cash!

text_block_list.name: School Receptionist
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say so, we cannot waive tuition fees.
Besides, with such a scrawny build, even if you
took the entrance test...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What'd you say?! My build... Don't judge me
before I even try! ...Fine, forget it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Turned away right at the door. Brushed off
coldly without even bein' allowed to try.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it was rainin' just like this
back on that day, too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To think that happened... Now that you mention it,
I remember being told something similar.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
'It's reckless for someone from the local circuit
to challenge the Central League. No matter how strong
you are, you won't cut it in the Twinkle Series.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You too, Oguri? That must've been rough.
People who judge without knowin' will never
understand how we feel.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But they also told me that innate handicaps
are just unavoidable...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Handicaps? A handicap, huh...
Is this really a handicap, though?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it's tough, if ya wanna call it tough.
But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! Dammit all!!
Screw your stupid school! Just you wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm scrawny, this body was given to me
by Ma and Pa. I'll win fair and square
with this very body!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
On that day, my mind was made up. Someday,
I'll show 'em all. I'll become the top horse girl in Naniwa!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: From that moment on, my dream started runnin'.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, not bein' blessed ain't a handicap.
Because I was poor and scrawny, I became who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Every single thing I was born with
—is my own power!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, the rain...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like it stopped. Alright, let's go,
Oguri! Race ya to the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whatever blocks my path, I'll tear it to shreds
with these legs! 'Cause I'm—the "White Lightning"!
